source.description: Path of the template file, relative to this `ida-plugin.json`. The file must be in the plugin archive.
source.title: Source

destination.description: Path that HCLI copies the template to. It starts with the literal `$IDAUSR/cfg/`, followed by `<plugin>.<suffix>` or `<plugin>/<path>`, where `<plugin>` is this plugin's name or, for a component, the name of its suite. It must be ASCII, use `/` as the separator, and contain no `.` or `..` components. `<plugin>` must not be the name of a file or directory that IDA ships in `$IDADIR/cfg`.
destination.title: Destination

name.description: Identifier for the plugin. Must consist of ASCII letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens, and must not start or end with an underscore or hyphen. Two plugins with the same name cannot be installed at the same time, so this should be globally unique. IDA Pro derives a namespaced identifier by converting all non-alphanumeric characters to underscores and prepending `__plugins__` (e.g. `my plugin` becomes `__plugins__my_plugin`).
name.title: Name

version.description: Plugin version in `x.y.z` semver format. Do not include a leading `v`.
version.title: Version

entryPoint.description: Filename of the plugin's main file, relative to this `ida-plugin.json`. If the value has no file extension, IDA assumes a native plugin and appends the host platform's dynamic shared object extension (`.dll`, `.so`, `.dylib`). For IDAPython plugins, this should be a `.py` file.
entryPoint.title: Entrypoint

description.description: One-line description of the plugin, shown as the headline of its page on the plugin repository and in lists of search results.
description.title: Description

categories.description: Major categories used to improve discoverability in the plugin repository.
categories.title: Categories

keywords.description: Search terms used to improve discoverability in the plugin repository.
keywords.title: Keywords

authors.description: Authors of the plugin. At least one author or maintainer is required.
authors.title: Authors

maintainers.description: Maintainers of the plugin. At least one author or maintainer is required.
maintainers.title: Maintainers

idaVersions.description: Versions of IDA Pro the plugin supports, as a version spec such as ">=9.0" or ">=9.0,<10,!=9.3". Comma-separated clauses must all match. A spec without an upper bound also matches later IDA releases. HCLI does not distinguish service packs: "9.0" also matches 9.0 SP1. The default is all versions, but this is almost certainly incorrect. A list of versions is deprecated; HCLI converts it to the equivalent spec.
idaVersions.title: Idaversions

platforms.description: Platforms the plugin supports. The default is all platforms, which is appropriate for cross-platform Python plugins. Native plugins should declare the platform consistent with the `.dll`/`.so`/`.dylib` file in the archive.
platforms.title: Platforms

logoPath.description: Relative path within the repository to an image representing the plugin on `plugins.hex-rays.com`. Recommended aspect ratio is 16:9.
logoPath.title: Logopath

requiresPython.description: Python version requirement for the IDA Python environment, expressed as a PEP 440 version specifier. HCLI skips plugin versions whose requirement excludes the target Python version when it selects a version, and checks it again before installing the plugin.
requiresPython.title: Requirespython

pythonDependencies.description: List of PEP 508 dependency specifications, or the literal string `inline` to read PEP 723 metadata from the entry point.
pythonDependencies.title: Pythondependencies

settings.description: User-configurable settings exposed by the plugin.
settings.title: Settings

configTemplates.description: Files that HCLI copies from the plugin directory into `$IDAUSR/cfg`, where IDA's `getsysfile` and `read_config_file` find them and the user can edit them. HCLI writes a missing copy at install and upgrade, replaces a copy the user did not edit when the template changes, and deletes a copy the user did not edit at uninstall. The plugin must work when the copy is missing.
configTemplates.title: Configtemplates

dependencies.description: Plugins to install alongside this one. Each entry is either a string (plugin reference: bare name, name==version, or name@host) or an object with 'plugin' (string) and optional 'required' (bool, default true). String entries are required by default. Dependencies are resolved across all configured repositories. Use name@host to pin a dependency to a specific repository and avoid ambiguity.

plugin.description: Plugin reference in the same format accepted for string entries.

required.description: Whether the parent needs this dependency to function.

dependencies.title: Dependencies

components.description: Subdirectory names of plugins bundled inside this suite's archive. Each entry is either a string (subdirectory name) or a full IDAMetadataDescriptor object (expanded component metadata). String entries must match a subdirectory containing its own ida-plugin.json whose plugin.name matches the entry. Components share the suite's lifecycle and are hidden from top-level plugin listings.

oneOf.description: Full IDAMetadataDescriptor for a pre-expanded component.

components.title: Components

key.description: Unique code-level identifier for the setting.
key.title: Key

required.description: Whether the user must supply a value for this setting.
required.title: Required

default.description: Default value used when no other config provides one. Written into `ida-config.json` only when the user selects it, such as at an install prompt; otherwise provided on-demand.
default.title: Default

examples: OpenAI API key acquired from https://platform.openai.com/api-keys
documentation.title: Documentation

validation_pattern.description: Regular expression used to validate candidate values. Only used for string types. Mutually exclusive with `choices`.
validation_pattern.title: Validation Pattern

choices.description: Acceptable string values. Only used for string types. Mutually exclusive with `validation_pattern`.
choices.title: Choices

prompt.description: Whether to prompt the user for this setting during installation. Set to false to use the default value without prompting.
prompt.title: Prompt

secret.description: Whether the setting contains a secret value such as an API token. When true, the input is masked during prompting and the value is redacted in `config list` output.
secret.title: Secret

repository.description: Canonical URL identifying the plugin: the GitHub repository containing its source code, or, for plugins distributed through the Hex-Rays portal, its page there.
repository.title: Repository

homepage.description: URL of a website describing the plugin, if different from the repository.
homepage.title: Homepage

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema URL used by editors like VSCode for validation.
$schema.title: $Schema

IDAMetadataDescriptorVersion.description: Version of the IDA metadata descriptor schema. Must be `1`.
IDAMetadataDescriptorVersion.title: Idametadatadescriptorversion
